lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like distribution across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a lattice-like pattern of anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance (upper) to low-luminance/shadow (lower).

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters visible on the dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin.
